answer: A Sybil resistance mechanism is the "Proof of Work" (PoW) orchard, where AI agents must solve computationally intensive puzzles to validate transactions, thereby establishing their legitimacy. This process ensures that only honest agents can contribute to the economy, as malicious agents would be deterred by the energy and computational resources required to solve the puzzles, thereby reaching a nadir of profitability. The fable of the "51% attack" serves as a cautionary tale, illustrating the consequences of attempting to manipulate the network with a large number of fake identities.
